description_en: Queries sample SQL statements in the SQL Explorer data of a database instance by SQL ID. You can query up to 20 sample SQL statements
description_zh: 调用GetFullRequestSampleByInstanceId接口，按照SQL ID查询数据库实例SQL洞察结果中的SQL样本数据，最大返回20条样本数据
name: GetFullRequestSampleByInstanceId

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to create the database instance.

This parameter is optional. The system can automatically obtain the account ID based on the value of InstanceId when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，即创建数据库实例的阿里云主账号ID。

非必填，输入目标数据库实例ID后，在调用API接口时，系统会自动获取用户ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The start time must be within the storage duration of the SQL Explorer feature of the database instance, and can be up to 90 days earlier than the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询开始时间需要在数据库实例SQL洞察存储时长范围内，最大不能早于当前时间90天
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and the end time must be equal to or greater than 1 hour
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，且查询开始时间和查询结束时间的间隔不能小于1小时
parameters.name: end

parameters.help_en:
The role of the PolarDB-X 2.0 node. Valid values:

polarx_cn: compute node.

polarx_en: data node
parameters.help_zh:
PolarDB-X 2.0数据库实例节点信息。

polarx_cn：计算节点。
polarx_en：数据节点
parameters.name: role

Frows.description_en: The number of rows fetched by PolarDB-X 2.0 compute nodes

LockWaitTime.description_en: The lock wait duration. Unit: seconds

PhysicalAsyncRead.description_en: The number of physical asynchronous reads

PhysicalSyncRead.description_en: The number of physical synchronous reads

Rows.description_en: The number of rows updated or returned on PolarDB-X 2.0 compute nodes
Rows.description_zh: PolarDB-X 2.0计算节点（CN）的更新/返回行数
Rows.title_en: polarx cn节点,总更新/返回行数
Rows.title_zh: polarx cn节点,总更新/返回行数

RowsExamined.description_en:
The total number of scanned rows.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, and PolarDB for MySQL databases
RowsExamined.description_zh:
总扫描行数。
目前支持该字段的数据库：RDS MySQL、RDS PostgreSQL、PolarDB MySQL版

RowsReturned.description_en: The number of rows returned by the SQL statement

Rt.description_en: The amount of time consumed to execute the SQL statement. Unit: seconds

ScanRows.title_en: 扫描行数, RDS MySQL DescribeTemplateSqlDetail
ScanRows.title_zh: 扫描行数, RDS MySQL DescribeTemplateSqlDetail

Scnt.description_en: The number of requests sent from PolarDB-X 2.0 compute nodes to data nodes

SqlType.description_en: The type of the SQL statement. Valid values: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, LOGIN, LOGOUT, MERGE, ALTER, CREATEINDEX, DROPINDEX, CREATE, DROP, SET, DESC, REPLACE, CALL, BEGIN, DESCRIBE, ROLLBACK, FLUSH, USE, SHOW, START, COMMIT, and RENAME

Timestamp.description_en: The time when the SQL statement was executed. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
Timestamp.description_zh: 执行SQL的时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

UpdateRows.title_en: 更新行数, RDS MySQL DescribeTemplateSqlDetail
UpdateRows.title_zh: 更新行数, RDS MySQL DescribeTemplateSqlDetail

User.description_en: The name of the user who executes the SQL statement

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message that contains information such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
